About ScaleStream

ScaleStream is a Series-C distributed-systems platform powering real-time data pipelines for over 1,200 enterprise customers. We process more than 4 billion events per day and our team is hybrid across San Francisco, Brooklyn, and Berlin.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Core Platform team. You will own critical pieces of our streaming infrastructure and help us scale to 10x our current throughput by 2027. This role is hybrid in San Francisco; we expect 2 days/week in office.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate distributed systems that process millions of events per second
  • Lead the technical direction of one or more services in our Core Platform
  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers; participate in interview loops
  • Collaborate with PM, design, and SRE on cross-functional projects
  • Own production reliability for your services, including on-call rotation

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong proficiency with Python and/or Go
  • Production experience with distributed messaging systems (Kafka, NATS, Pulsar)
  • Experience operating Kubernetes in production
  • Deep familiarity with at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases at scale
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have

  • Experience with gRPC and Protocol Buffers
  • Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)
  • Open-source contributions to relevant projects
  • Experience with Rust
  • Public speaking or technical writing

Compensation and benefits

  • $180,000 - $230,000 base salary, depending on level and location
  • Equity grant in a Series-C company
  • Medical, dental, vision; 401(k) with 4% match
  • Sponsorship for work authorization is available for exceptional candidates
  • Unlimited PTO with a 3-week minimum

Equal opportunity

ScaleStream is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

Our team

The Core Platform team is 14 engineers split between San Francisco, Brooklyn, and Berlin. We use a trunk-based development model with continuous deployment to staging, daily releases to production, and quarterly major-version cycles. Our codebase is approximately 60% Python, 30% Go, with smaller pieces in Rust (for performance-critical paths) and TypeScript (for our internal tooling).

Engineers on this team typically rotate between projects every 4-6 months. We invest in technical-leadership growth through quarterly architecture reviews, internal RFC processes, and conference-talk support. Many engineers on this team have spoken at GopherCon, KubeCon, PyCon, and InfoQ events; we cover travel and registration costs.

Interview process

Our interview process consists of: (1) a 30-minute introductory call with a recruiter; (2) a 60-minute technical screen focused on system design fundamentals; (3) an on-site loop of four 60-minute interviews covering coding, system design, behavioral, and a project deep-dive; (4) a final 30-minute conversation with the hiring manager. We aim to reach a decision within 5 business days of the on-site loop. We provide structured feedback regardless of outcome.

Tip for candidates: come prepared to discuss a recent technical project in depth, including the design tradeoffs you considered, the production challenges you encountered, and what you'd do differently in hindsight. We are far more interested in how you reason through problems than in whether you arrive at our preferred answer.
